machine.description: High-speed automated optical inspection and 3D laser profilometry line for inspecting molded IC package surface defects, lead coplanarity, ball grid height, and package dimensional tolerances.
machine.manufacturingProcess: Molded leadframe strips or BGA trays travel along a dual-lane SMEMA conveyor. Multi-wavelength RGB+W dome illumination and dual-telecentric cameras capture 100MP images while 3D laser triangulation sensors reconstruct micron-level height maps of leads and solder balls.
subsystems: Multi-Angle RGBW Programmable Dome Strobe Illuminator
Granite Base Air-Bearing Linear Motion Gantry

components.name: 3D Laser Triangulation Head
components.function: Scans package surface height and lead coplanarity at 50 kHz.
components.importantParameters: Height measurement resolution (0.1µm), laser power (mW), sensor temp (°C).
components.degradationIndicators: Laser diode power decay, height measurement noise.

components.name: Camera Motion Gantry
components.function: Translates optical sensor across package matrix at high speed.
components.degradationIndicators: Gantry vibration rise (>0.2 mm/s), position encoder error.

components.name: RGBW LED Dome Illuminator
components.function: Provides structured multi-angle illumination for defect contrast.

sensors.name: Camera Gantry Vibration
sensors.purpose: Monitors optical gantry motion vibration and rail smoothness.

sensors.name: Optical Sensor Temp
sensors.purpose: Measures CMOS image sensor and laser diode temperature.

sensors.name: Illumination Uniformity
sensors.purpose: Monitors calibrated brightness uniformity of LED dome lights.

warning.description: Gantry bearing wear or belt looseness

critical.description: Image blur causing false defect classification

normal.description: Measures CMOS image sensor and laser diode temperature.

operatingConditions.recommendedOperatingConditions: Optical lenses free of dust, calibration target scanned every 24h

maintenance.maintenanceAction: Lens optical cleaning and 3D target calibration
maintenance.procedureSummary: Clean front telecentric element with optical lens paper, run 3D grid calibration target.

degradationIndicators.degradationSignificance: Causes motion blur and false coplanarity rejections

symptoms.recommendedAction: Clean telecentric lens and execute standard 3D target calibration.
